result.summary: Found 2 issues: one major layout truncation issue and one minor visual inconsistency.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge. Both the image and the restaurant name are truncated, hiding content from the user.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal scroll container properly indicates that it is scrollable (e.g., show a partial card peek with clear affordance), or adjust card sizing so names are not clipped in a misleading way. Consider adding a visible scroll indicator.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is partially cut off at the bottom of the screen with a '-20%' badge visible, but no restaurant name or details are shown, providing no context to the user.
issues.suggestion: Show at least the restaurant name below the image, or ensure the card is fully visible before the fold, or add a visible scroll indicator so users know to scroll down for more content.
